blocks.text: Architecting a Hybrid Cloud Foundation for India's Most Trusted Two-Wheeler Manufacturer
Manufacturing

blocks.alt: person wearing long-sleeve top working on laptop

blocks.text: Client
A household name and one of the most trusted brands in India, this multi-billion-dollar enterprise is a leading manufacturer of motorcycles.
Ambition

To modernize their core communication infrastructure to support a rapidly expanding workforce and global operations, while adhering to data residency laws and avoiding prohibitive capital expenditure.
Outcome

Architected a cost-effective, hybrid IaaS solution that saved crores of rupees in capital investment, met international data residency requirements, and delivered a highly available, high-performance platform.
The Ambition
A household name and one of the most trusted brands in India, this multi-billion-dollar enterprise is a leading manufacturer of motorcycles.
The Challenge

Their on-premise IT infrastructure was being stretched to its limits. The cost to expand and upgrade their existing email servers was prohibitively high. Furthermore, their international operations required them to comply with local data residency laws (e.g., in Singapore), which would have necessitated building multiple, expensive data centers. They needed a solution that was both economically viable and globally compliant.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to build an IT infrastructure that could support their next phase of growth, both within India and internationally. They needed to upgrade their overburdened on-premise email system to a modern platform that could handle high volumes and provide reliable service to thousands of geographically distributed users.
Ambition, Realized

The hybrid solution delivered the best of both worlds. The client gained a modern, high-performance, and reliable platform while saving crores of rupees in upfront capital expenditure. The ability to deploy resources in specific global datacenters allowed them to satisfy all data residency requirements with ease. Downtime and security risks were virtually eliminated, providing their IT team with a stable, scalable foundation to support the company's continued growth.
Key Business Impact
Saved Crores in Upfront Capital Expenditure
Met International Data Residency & Compliance Requirements
Delivered a High-Performance & Highly Available Platform
Reduced Operational Downtime & Security Risks
